and [[2016 America East men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |bowl = [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = First Round }} {{2015–16 America East Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Stony Brook Seawolves men's basketball team''' represented [[Stony Brook University]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Seawolves were led by the eleventh-year head coach [[Steve Pikiell]] and played their home games at [[Island Federal Credit Union Arena]]. They were members of the [[America East Conference]]. They finished the season 26–7, 14–2 in America East play to win the regular-season championship. They defeated [[2015–16 UMBC Retrievers men's basketball team|UMBC]], [[2015–16 Hartford Hawks men's basketball team|Hartford]], and [[2015–16 Vermont Catamounts men's basketball team|Vermont]] to become champions of the [[2016 America East men's basketball tournament|America East tournament]] and earn the conference's automatic bid goes the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], their first in school history. As a #13 seed, the Seawolves fell to [[2015–16 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in the first round. On March 20, it was announced that head coach Steve Pikiell would leave the school to accept the job as the new head coach for [[Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball|Rutgers]]. He finished at Stony Brook with an eleven-year record of 192–157. ==Previous season== The [[2014–15 Stony Brook Seawolves men's basketball team|Seawolves]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] 23–12, 12–4 in America East play to finish in a tie for second place. They advanced to the championship game of the [[2015 America East men's basketball tournament|America East tournament]] where they lost to [[2014–15 Albany Great Danes men's basketball team|Albany]]. They were invited to the [[2015 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they lost in the first round to [[2014–15 Mercer Bears men's basketball team|Mercer]]. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
